description: React component for an accordion UI displaying chapters, modules, and challenges within a super block structure for the FreeCodeCamp curriculum.

methods.name: Chapter
methods.description: React component representing a chapter, with optional link and expandable content.

methods.name: Module
methods.description: React component representing a module within a chapter, with expandable content and optional coming soon message.

methods.name: LinkModule
methods.description: Component rendering a link block for specific challenge modules.

methods.name: SuperBlockAccordion
methods.description: Main exported component rendering the entire super block structure with chapters, modules, and challenges.
